title: Bump @deepseek-ai/schemastery to 3.18.4 in the DSH integration
summary: A dependency-only change: the DSH integration's devDependency on @deepseek-ai/schemastery moves from 3.18.2 to 3.18.4, and the pnpm lockfile gains the new resolution and snapshot entries for that version. No application code, schema definitions or runtime wiring change — the only thing that moves is which copy of the schema-validation library the DSH workspace resolves at install time.
